verbatim_excerpt:
23-362 Maximum lot coverage in R6 through R12 Districts

R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

(a) For standard lots

In the districts indicated, the maximum #residential# #lot coverage# for #interior lots# or #through lots# shall be 80 percent and the maximum #residential# #lot coverage# for #corner lots# shall be 100 percent.

(b) For eligible sites

In the districts indicated, for #zoning lots# with #buildings# utilizing the eligible site provisions of Section 23-434 (Height and setback modifications for eligible sites), the maximum #residential# #lot coverage# of the entire site shall be:

(1) 65 percent on #zoning lots# with a #lot area# of 30,000 square feet or more that are not #large sites#; and

(2) 50 percent on #large sites#.

Individual #corner lot#, #interior lot#, or #through lot# portions may exceed such overall maximum, provided they do not exceed the respective maximums that would apply to #zoning lots# that are not utilizing the eligible site provisions.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks of the section body joined by blank lines, in page order: [0] the section number and title as displayed; [1] the district list; then each paragraph. A list item is written with the label the print/PDF render prints in front of it ((a), (b), ... for the outer list; (1), (2), ... for a nested list), followed by one space; an item's heading line and its text (separated by a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks. Defined terms (bold italic in the HTML) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF render writes them, inner spacing included. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures (images whose alt text is an editor's caption, not Resolution text) are omitted; no word was changed.

notes: Captured as the governing-source candidate for R6-R12 maximum residential lot coverage (ZR 23-362, City of Yes for Housing Opportunity, Last Amended 12/5/2024). Lane A item A-02b encodes paragraph (a) for R6B ONLY (rule r6b-lot-coverage); paragraph (b) is carried here and not encoded.

Paragraph (a) states one value per lot type: interior lots or through lots 80 percent; corner lots 100 percent. The lot type (#corner lot#, #interior lot#, #through lot#, defined terms of ZR 12-10 that are NOT captured here) is a site fact the rule consumes as an input, never derives.

DISTRICT SCOPE FOR R6B: the section's district list names 'R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12' but not R6B. ZR 11-25 (snapshot zr-11-25, 'District Designations Appended with Suffixes') states that all regulations applicable to a district designation apply to that designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions, and that if a section lists an R4 District its provisions also apply to R4-1, R4A and R4B unless separate provisions for the suffixed districts are listed within the section. This section lists no separate provision for any suffixed R6 district, so its R6 provisions reach R6B through ZR 11-25 - a reading of 11-25, not an express naming of R6B, to be confirmed by the reviewer (Q12) together with 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions' caveat.

Paragraph (b) applies only to zoning lots with buildings utilizing the eligible-site provisions of Section 23-434 (not captured); its closing paragraph lets individual corner, interior or through lot portions exceed the site-wide maximum up to the paragraph (a) values.

Sibling section titles visible in the captured page's navigation (titles only; their text was NOT captured and nothing here relies on it): 23-36 Maximum Lot Coverage; 23-361 Maximum lot coverage in R1 through R5 Districts; 23-363 Special rules for certain interior or through lots; 23-38 Special Rules for Certain Areas (23-381 Special provisions in other geographies); 23-70 Alternative Bulk Regulations for Certain Areas (23-71, 23-72, 23-73).
